assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready isolated vegetation sprite for LETZTE SCHICHT, a gritty 2D side-view industrial survival game. Create ONE complete tree as a game sprite on a genuinely TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, without any background color, checkerboard pattern, floor, terrain patch, horizon, cast shadow, border, text, label, watermark, or extra objects. Strict orthographic side elevation, entire tree including bare root tip visible, centered horizontally with root tip at about 94% image height, generous clear margin on all four sides. Crisp detailed pixel-art style with deliberate small pixel clusters, angular organic branching, limited muted natural palette and dark outlines; no soft painted blur, no 3D render, no isometric projection. Readable silhouette at 160 pixels tall. Light from upper left, restrained earthy highlights. Crown must have irregular negative gaps, separate bough clusters, believable trunk and fine branches; avoid a round lollipop outline. Keep all tree pixels separated from image edges. Square canvas. Subject: one mature, slightly wind-shaped deciduous birch-like industrial wasteland tree. Crooked dark charcoal-brown trunk with subtle pale bark scars, multiple visible forked branches, asymmetrical crown of muted olive-green and sage leaf clusters, some rusty brown foliage at tips. Detailed rugged bark and sparse exposed roots, no ground. Broad but irregular spreading crown; overall tree about twice as tall as the trunk before the crown.
